'''Ezekiel''' is one of the [[boss]]es in [[The Fractured Archive]] raid. He is a [[Saradomin]]ist [[justiciar]] who came to the Fractured Archive seeking artefacts worthy of Saradomin. He believes the ends always justify the means. Players have the option during a given raid of The Fractured Archive to fight either Ezekiel or [[Bork]] and the [[Smork]]s as the second boss encounter.

==Enrage Phase==
[[File:Ezekial Enrage Phase dodged perfectly.mp4|left|thumb|width=354x354|Perfect Dodges]]
During Enrage phase, Ezekial brings all players into a 3x3 arena and begins shooting volleys of 3 lightning attacks.
The volley of attacks are indicated by which swords are struck with lightning.  These attacks can be dodged by running opposite of the lightning that strikes.

==Trivia==
* Ezekiel appears to be wearing some type of [[justiciar]] armour. However, its style does not match that of any known groups of justiciars.
* {{wp|Ezekiel}} was a biblical priest and prophet whose name means "God is strong" or "God strengthens" in Hebrew.
